text:
anya: quick sanity check — ran two-pass speculative prefetch on draft-model-3.2-quant4. saw ~1.9x throughput on long-chat workloads but a small token-level quality drop on code generation prompts. anyone else observe mismatch vs fp16 baseline?

sam_w: which dataset + config? was this with KV-cache warmup or cold starts?

anya: repro on our internal code-mixed eval (codeblends-2026), batch=8 seq_len=1024, prefetch_depth=16, speculative_threshold=0.35. cold start tests included. KV cache warming enabled between passes.

julian: fwiw i ran a quick sweep yesterday — similar perf gains but i saw 0.6–1.2% decrease in exact-match on unit-test style prompts when prefetch_depth >= 12. lower depth (6–8) kept EM stable but less speedup.

anya: nice, can you paste the perf command you used?

julian: sure —
```bash
python bench_decode.py --model draft-model-3.2-quant4 \
  --dataset codeblends-2026 --batch 8 --seq 1024 \
  --spec-prefetch 16 --spec-threshold 0.35 \
  --kv-warmup --runs 5
```

julian: logs showed fallback hits ~4% (requests where second-pass returned different top token and we fell back to baseline).

ci-bot: nightly-eval: draft-model-3.2-quant4 spec-prefetch=16 -> throughput +90%, EM (codeblends) -0.9%, safety-regressions: none detected. Full report: https://ci.internal/reports/19675

marie_k: suggestion for evaluation methodology: split eval into targeted strata — (A) short code snippets (<200 toks), (B) long code with context (>400 toks), (C) mixed chat. Measure both seq-level EM and token-level KL / logprob delta vs fp16 baseline. Also track fallback rate and where it occurs (prefix vs suffix).

anya: good call. i suspect regressions cluster on long multi-turn stateful examples where the speculative pass uses stale KV cache assumptions.

sam_w: add to that: track where deterministic tokens diverge (e.g., punctuation/paren tokens) — code is brittle to small diffs. maybe increase spec threshold for code stratum.

julian: agreed. i'll run a targeted sweep: prefetch_depth in [6,8,10,12], spec_threshold in [0.25,0.35,0.45], stratified by A/B/C. will dump diffs and fallback contexts.

anya: thanks. action items: julian run sweep and upload diffs; marie define metric table for EM/KL/fallback; sam add small script to extract token divergence locations. i'll queue a short postmortem note in docs after we confirm. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: job queued: infra/bench/sweeps/19675 (estimated 3h)

marie_k: if we see consistency, we can push a policy: spec_prefetch depth <=8 for code workloads by default and auto-relax for chat/long-text.

anya: sounds good. i'll annotate the model rollout config with that policy to avoid accidental regressions for customers.

julian: starting runs now, will ping when done (@anya @sam_w).
